summary: The function keys of an entry screen as one row of buttons, each showing its key and the word of its operation.
not_for: A screen of a product whose conventions show no function keys (keys.display none): its actions are ordinary buttons.

rules.rule: The function keys of the screen are shown together in one row, at the foot of the screen, in the order of the keys.
Each entry shows its key and the word of its operation, and runs by the key and by a click alike.
The row lists the keys this screen runs; a key with no operation here is left out. An operation the conventions give no key is a button after the keys, with its word alone.
The words are the ones the conventions give, and the row carries no caption.

evidence.source: PCA 会計シリーズ マニュアル, ボタン、メニューバー、キーなどの操作
evidence.says: The shortcuts on function keys are shown together at the foot of the screen, and each can be pressed or clicked.

evidence.source: OBC 勘定奉行J11, 機能
evidence.says: The buttons on the screen correspond to the function keys F1 to F12.

evidence.source: 弥生販売 サポート情報, 弥生販売のショートカットキー一覧
evidence.says: F12 登録 registers a slip or a ledger record, F9 削除 deletes it, F2 新規作成 clears the screen for a new one, F8 参照 opens the lookup of the field under the cursor, and Ctrl+F 検索 opens a screen where conditions are set to find slips.
